Static trace: the app's LE connection handler 0421465e (event dispatcher 04217546) treats a central that is neither a known ring (0424eef2) nor the bonded phone (042133e2 / address DAT_0201132c) as foreign: it stores the peer at DAT_020128ac and posts app event 0x3f3 after 2000 ms, whose handler calls 04318dca (opcode 0x2bc) toward the peer and retries at count x 1000 ms; gatt_disconnect is 04319c04 (opcode 0x21f, BT core bt_service_gatt_disconnect 0x14060f06), called from 0421465e and app_ble 042de6a6. This is stock policy toward unbonded centrals (the iPhone, bonded for ANCS, passes), so the channel must be tested from an iPhone or the policy patched.
